items.title: File Widerspruch against refusal of orthopedic insoles coverage
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid kann innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Widerspruch erhoben werden.
items.computation: Letter dated Mon 14 Apr 2025 (posting day). As a social-insurance (SGB V/SGB X) letter sent by ordinary post, it counts as delivered on the 4th day after posting under § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X: Fri 18 Apr 2025 (this day does not shift even though it is a public holiday, Karfreitag, for this type of delivery rule). Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the one-month Widerspruch period (§ 84 Abs. 1 SGG) starts the next day and ends one month later per § 188 Abs. 1 BGB: Sun 18 May 2025. Since that is a Sunday, § 26 Abs. 3 SGB X shifts the deadline to the next business day: Mon 19 May 2025.

warnings: The letter does not state a specific reimbursement amount for the conventional insoles (only "abzüglich der gesetzlichen Zuzahlung"), so no amount could be extracted.
